title: most lossless codelength consumed by imperceptible details
description: The majority of the model's lossless codelengths are spent on describing imperceptible image details, rather than perceptually important structure.
canonical_description: most bits in lossless codelength describe imperceptible image details

evidence.quote: We find that the majority of our models' lossless codelengths are consumed to describe imperceptible image details
